services.intro:
UPQ (Rust Price Query Service) - Price query service with API compatibility against the Python price_query_service.

## Date/Time Formats
- **ISO Datetime**: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS` (required for minute-level endpoints)
- **Date**: `YYYY-MM-DD` (for daily endpoints)

## Error Responses
All errors return JSON with `code` and `message` fields:
```json
{
  "code": "invalid_argument",
  "message": "start/end must be ISO datetime: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS"
}
```

endpoints.description: Returns available option query endpoints

Query option chain by underlying asset with optional filters.
Returns all options for a given underlying on a specific date.
For exact expiry queries (`expiry_min == expiry_max`), if no rows match,
the service automatically falls back to the nearest available expiry:
first within ±7 calendar days, then (if still empty) within the same calendar month.
Fallback candidate search stays within the same underlying/type/strike filter context.
Nearest is selected by absolute day difference; ties pick the earlier expiry.

params.name: expiry_min
params.description:
Minimum expiration date filter.
If `expiry_min` equals `expiry_max` and no exact rows exist,
nearest-expiry fallback may apply.

params.name: expiry_max

Maximum expiration date filter.
If `expiry_min` equals `expiry_max` and no exact rows exist,
nearest-expiry fallback may apply.

params.name: session_id

mcp.name: research_eval_factor
mcp.summary: Evaluate an intraday factor: IC, rank IC, ICIR, t-stats, quantile returns,     long-short spread, turnover and IC by hour, for each forward horizon.
mcp.description:
The factor is one expression over per-minute fields, e.g.
    "cs_rank(-pct(close, 15))" or "ts_zscore(close - vwap, 60) * cs_rank(volume)".
    Fields: open high low close volume transactions vwap ret minute
    (+ bid ask mid spread imbalance when stock quotes exist).
    Functions: ts_mean ts_sum ts_std ts_min ts_max ts_zscore (x, n);
    ts_corr ts_cov (x, y, n); delay delta pct (x, n>=1); cs_rank cs_zscore
    cs_demean (x); abs log sign sqrt; max min (a, b). Windows only look back and
    reset each day unless cross_day. Signals trade at the next bar's open.

params.name: expression
params.description: the factor start / end: YYYY-MM-DD trading-day range

params.name: universe
params.description: explicit tickers; default is top_n by prior-day dollar volume

params.name: session_id
params.description: Optional PMB session to time-lock this query to (data after the session's current bar is hidden, enforced server-side).

mcp.returns: JSON with: server_time_utc, events[], next_cursor

mcp.name: esp_timeline
mcp.summary: Get a compact time-bucketed summary of events for specific tickers.
mcp.description:
Useful for scanning what happened to a stock over a period without
    fetching every individual event.

params.name: tickers
params.description: Stock symbols to fetch timeline for, e.g. ["AAPL", "NVDA"]

params.name: bucket_minutes
params.description: Bucket size in minutes (default 60 = hourly buckets)

params.name: now_utc
params.description: Override current time for backtesting replay (ISO datetime)

params.name: session_id
params.description: Optional PMB session to time-lock this query to (data after the session's current bar is hidden, enforced server-side).

mcp.returns: JSON with: server_time_utc, buckets[] Each bucket has: bucket_start_utc, bucket_end_utc, count, events[]

mcp.name: pmb_add_contracts
mcp.summary: Load option contracts into a running session so they can be traded and marked.
mcp.description:
Use upq_option_chain to discover contract identifiers (e.g. O:AAPL240328C00170000),
    then add them here before placing option orders.
mcp.returns: JSON with {ok, loaded, skipped}.

mcp.name: pmb_add_stocks
mcp.summary: Add stock symbols to a running session (grow the watchlist / tradable universe).
mcp.description: The new symbols are priced and tradable from the current bar onward.
mcp.returns: JSON with {ok, loaded, skipped}.

mcp.name: pmb_buy_option
mcp.summary: Place a BUY order for an option contract.

params.name: contract
params.description: OPRA contract string, e.g. "O:NVDA250117C00136000" Use upq_make_opra() to build this string.

params.name: limit_price
params.description: Per-share price (not per contract) for LIMIT orders

mcp.returns: JSON order object with order_id and initial status

mcp.name: pmb_buy_stock
mcp.summary: Place a BUY order for a stock.

params.name: limit_price
params.description: Required for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT orders

params.name: stop_price
params.description: Required for STOP and STOP_LIMIT orders

params.name: time_in_force
params.description: "DAY" (default, expires at the end of the trading date it first becomes eligible on), "GTC" (good till cancel) or "GTD" (needs expire_ts)

params.name: client_order_id
params.description: Optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate orders

params.name: trading_hours
params.description: "REGULAR" (09:30-16:00 ET, default), "EXTENDED" (04:00-20:00 ET) or "OVERNIGHT" (24/5 incl. 20:00-04:00 ET). Outside REGULAR only LIMIT orders are accepted.

params.name: expire_ts
params.description: ISO time a GTD order expires

mcp.returns: JSON order object with: order_id, status, instrument, side, qty, order_type

mcp.name: pmb_cancel_order
mcp.summary: Cancel an open order.

params.name: session_id

params.name: account_id
params.description: The account the order belongs to

mcp.name: pmb_create_account
mcp.summary: Allocate a new paper trading (broker) account.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Account open date "YYYY-MM-DD" (required — the first trading day)

params.name: initial_cash
params.description: Starting cash; omit to use the broker default (pmb_get_config)

params.name: market
params.description: "us", "cn", or "hk"; omit to use the broker default. Determines the account-number prefix, base currency, and exchange timezone.

mcp.returns: JSON with: account_id (a unique 10-digit number), market, created_at, account. Save the account_id — you'll need it for all subsequent calls.

mcp.name: pmb_create_session
mcp.summary: Create a new backtesting / simulation session.

params.name: account_id
params.description: The account to trade in (from pmb_create_account)

params.name: frequency
params.description: Time step size — "1m" (minute bars) or "1d" (daily bars)

params.name: start_ts
params.description: Session start "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS" or "YYYY-MM-DD" e.g. "2024-01-02T09:30:00" for minute, "2024-01-02" for daily

params.name: end_ts
params.description: Session end datetime, same format as start_ts

params.name: option_universe
params.description: Option contracts to include, e.g. ["O:SPY250117C00500000"] (use upq_make_opra or a chain query to get symbols)

params.name: future_universe
params.description: Futures to include: contracts ("ZNZ6") or front-month roots ("ZN", "CL", "GC"); they trade around the clock (CME 18:00-17:00 ET) and settle daily

mcp.returns: JSON with: session_id, account_id, clock (frequency, current_ts, end_ts, status) Save the session_id — you'll need it to step and place orders.

mcp.name: pmb_end_day
mcp.summary: Close the current trading day and FREEZE the account.
mcp.description:
Records the day into the account's trading history. While frozen, trades are
    rejected until pmb_next_day is called.
mcp.returns: JSON with the closed day record and the updated (frozen) account status.

mcp.name: pmb_export_session
mcp.summary: Export full session data for external analysis.
mcp.returns: Session trade history and performance data in the requested format

mcp.name: pmb_get_account
mcp.summary: Get the current state of a paper trading account.
mcp.returns: JSON with: cash_available, cash_locked, loan, equity, buying_power, margin_status, positions summary

mcp.name: pmb_get_config
mcp.summary: Get the broker settings that govern fills, fees, leverage, and defaults.
mcp.description:
Returns fees (per share / per option contract), slippage, buying-power
    leverage, initial cash, default market/frequency, and the fill price rule.

mcp.name: pmb_get_history
mcp.summary: Get an account's step-by-step trading history (one record per trading day).

params.name: limit
params.description: Optional — return only the most recent N days

mcp.returns: JSON list of day records: trading_day, date, opening_equity, closing_equity, realized_pnl, num_trades, fees, trades[], positions[].

mcp.name: pmb_get_market
mcp.summary: Get the current market state for a session (latest prices for all instruments).
mcp.returns: JSON with current market data for all instruments in the session universe

mcp.name: pmb_get_orders
mcp.summary: Query orders for an account, optionally filtered by session.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Optional — filter to orders from a specific session

mcp.returns: JSON list of order objects with: order_id, symbol, side, order_type, qty, filled_qty, avg_fill_price, status, created_ts

mcp.name: pmb_get_positions
mcp.summary: List all current open positions in a paper trading account.
mcp.returns: JSON list of position objects with: symbol, qty, avg_cost, market_value, unrealized_pnl, side

mcp.name: pmb_get_status
mcp.summary: Query the broker status of an account by its 10-digit id.
mcp.returns: JSON with: market, status (ACTIVE/FROZEN/CLOSED), trading_day, current_date, cash, equity, realized_pnl, unrealized_pnl, total_return, positions, trades_today. When status is FROZEN you must call pmb_next_day before trading.

mcp.name: pmb_get_summary
mcp.summary: Get backtesting performance summary for a session.

params.name: session_id
params.description: The session identifier (session should be finished or stopped)

mcp.returns: JSON with: final_equity, total_return, max_drawdown, fees_paid, num_orders, num_trades, sharpe_ratio (and other metrics)

mcp.name: pmb_get_trades
mcp.summary: Query executed trades for an account, optionally filtered by session.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Optional — filter to trades from a specific session

mcp.returns: JSON list of trade objects with execution details and realized P&L

mcp.name: pmb_health
mcp.summary: Check health of the PMB (Paper Money Broker) trading simulation service.

mcp.name: pmb_next_day
mcp.summary: Unfreeze the account and advance to the next trading day.
mcp.description:
If the current day was not explicitly ended, it is auto-closed first so the
    history stays contiguous.

params.name: date
params.description: Optional explicit "YYYY-MM-DD"; otherwise advances to the next weekday.

mcp.returns: JSON with the updated (active) account status on the new trading day.

mcp.name: pmb_quote
mcp.summary: Get the real UPQ market price for symbols at the account's trading day.
mcp.description: This is the exact price a no-price ``pmb_trade`` would fill at.
mcp.returns: JSON with as_of date, the price rule, prices per symbol, and any missing.

mcp.name: pmb_rewind
mcp.summary: Time-travel a session back to target_ts, undoing every order placed after it.
mcp.description:
The session is deterministically replayed to the target bar; any orders/fills
    that happened after target_ts are undone. Useful to explore alternate actions
    from an earlier point without recreating the session.

params.name: target_ts
params.description: ISO timestamp of the bar to return to (e.g. "2024-03-22T14:00:00+00:00"). The latest bar at or before this time becomes the new current bar.

mcp.returns: JSON with the rewound consolidated session state (same shape as pmb_session_state).

mcp.name: pmb_sell_option
mcp.summary: Place a SELL order for an option contract.
mcp.returns: JSON order object with order_id and initial status

mcp.name: pmb_sell_stock
mcp.summary: Place a SELL order for a stock.

params.name: limit_price
params.description: Required for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT orders

params.name: stop_price
params.description: Required for STOP and STOP_LIMIT orders

params.name: trading_hours
params.description: "REGULAR" (default), "EXTENDED" or "OVERNIGHT"; outside REGULAR only LIMIT orders are accepted

params.name: expire_ts
params.description: ISO time a GTD order expires

mcp.returns: JSON order object with: order_id, status, instrument, side, qty, order_type

mcp.name: pmb_session_state
mcp.summary: Get the full consolidated state of a session in one call.
mcp.description:
Returns clock (current bar, index, total bars, status), the account snapshot
    (cash, equity, buying power, margin), open positions, working orders, recent
    trades, and the current market quotes — everything an agent needs each step.
mcp.returns: JSON with clock, account, positions, open_orders, trades, and market.

mcp.name: pmb_step_session
mcp.summary: Advance the simulation clock by n time steps.
mcp.description:
Each step moves time forward by one period (1 minute or 1 day).
    The response contains market prices, order fills, account snapshots.
mcp.returns: JSON with: is_running  — false when session has ended (stop looping) current_ts  — current simulation timestamp status      — "RUNNING", "FINISHED", or "STOPPED" clock       — full clock state events[]    — list of events this step: MARKET_TICK      — stocks[] and options[] with OHLCV bars ORDER_EVENT      — order status changes (FILLED, CANCELLED, etc.) TRADE_EVENT      — individual trade executions ACCOUNT_SNAPSHOT — cash, equity, positions snapshot RISK_EVENT       — margin calls or risk alerts

mcp.name: pmb_step_until
mcp.summary: Advance the clock until something worth deciding on happens.
mcp.description:
Prefer this over many pmb_step_session calls in minute sessions: one call
    covers up to ``max_steps`` bars and stops at the first of
      - ``until_ts`` reached (ISO time),
      - an order fill (``stop_on_fill``, default true),
      - a price trigger, e.g. [{"symbol": "SPY", "op": ">=", "price": 600}],
      - entering a session segment (``stop_on_segment``, e.g. "REGULAR" to
        skip to the next open),
      - the session ending.
mcp.returns: JSON with steps, reason, clock (incl. segment and trading_date), the order/trade/risk events seen, last_tick (latest bars) and account.

mcp.name: pmb_stop_session
mcp.summary: Stop a running simulation session early.
mcp.returns: JSON confirmation of session termination

mcp.name: pmb_trade
mcp.summary: Execute an immediate paper trade against the account's broker book.
mcp.description:
Only allowed while the account is ACTIVE (rejected when FROZEN). Leave
    ``price`` unset to fill at the REAL UPQ market price for the account's
    current trading day (recommended — the response's ``price_source`` shows
    ``upq:close``). Use ``pmb_quote`` first if you want to see the price.

params.name: price
params.description: Optional override; omit to fill at the real market price

params.name: note
params.description: Optional free-text note attached to the fill

mcp.returns: JSON with the executed fill (incl. price_source) and updated account status.

mcp.name: pmb_trade_future
mcp.summary: Place a futures order (BUY or SELL; selling with no position opens a short).
mcp.description:
Futures are margined, not paid for: opening contracts need their initial
    margin free (equity minus the initial margin already in use), fills cost
    only fees, and each position settles daily at the session's settlement
    price (VARIATION_MARGIN events move the gain or loss into cash). When
    equity falls below maintenance margin the account is in a margin call
    (no new positions) until equity is back at initial margin; an unmet call
    is liquidated at a later settlement. The session state lists each
    contract's multiplier, tick size and margin per contract.

params.name: session_id
params.description: The active session (futures must be in its future_universe)

params.name: order_type
params.description: "MARKET" (default), "LIMIT", "STOP" or "STOP_LIMIT" limit_price / stop_price: Prices in the contract's quote units
